exposure: Gestational time point (non-labor, spontaneous term labor, preterm labor)
cohort: Mouse and human myometrial tissues and myometrial cells were studied.
finding: The study found that MYB and ELF3 genes exhibit elevated transcript expression levels in mouse and human myometrial tissues during spontaneous term labor and mifepristone-induced preterm labor, and they differentially modulate labor-driving gene promoter activity, suggesting a role in controlling labor timing.
